question: Should this PR be the landing path for both the `includeFamily` history contract and default-off session-family carryover, or should #90239 land the history API first and this PR rebase as a smaller carryover follow-up?
rationale: The implementation is bounded and tested, but it creates a new model-facing selector, an invalid parameter combination, a new config/default surface, and opt-in provider exposure of archived context; those are product/API choices rather than mechanical correctness issues.

options.title: Land family lookup first, then rebase carryover
options.body: Merge or otherwise settle #90239 as the canonical `includeFamily` API, then keep this PR focused on the default-off carryover transform and docs/proof.

options.title: Accept this combined stack
options.body: Treat this PR as the canonical landing path for both family history lookup and carryover, with maintainers owning the API/config/provider-boundary tradeoffs.

options.title: Defer carryover
options.body: Keep explicit family history retrieval but require a separate product discussion before any prompt carryover summary can be injected automatically.

recommendation.title: Land family lookup first, then rebase carryover
recommendation.body: Merge or otherwise settle #90239 as the canonical `includeFamily` API, then keep this PR focused on the default-off carryover transform and docs/proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The open decision centers on `sessions_history`/`chat.history` selector semantics and pagination behavior, where recent merged history points to this owner path.
